bio: Postdoctoral researcher in computational biology at the University of Tübingen and PhD candidate in Infectious Diseases at the University of São Paulo and Imperial College London. This page collects selected data visualizations, maps, phylogenies, and workflow diagrams from my ongoing doctoral thesis and published articles.
